Visitor skips all links entirely

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

type testVisitorVisitorSkipLinks struct{
	htmd.BaseVisitor
}
func (v *testVisitorVisitorSkipLinks) VisitLink(ctx htmd.NodeContext, href string, text string, title *string) htmd.VisitResult {
	return htmd.VisitResultSkip()
}

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	visitor := &testVisitorVisitorSkipLinks{}
	options.Visitor = visitor
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<p>Before <a href="https://example.com">link text</a> after</p>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result)
}
```
